IT equipment in hardness testing 
IT equipment is an indispensable part of modern hardness testing. By integrating advanced IT systems, testing processes can be made more efficient, precise, and traceable. From serial data transmission sets to powerful PC components, IT equipment offers numerous opportunities to optimize testing workflows.
Types of IT equipment 
Serial data transmission set:
These sets enable smooth transmission of test data between different devices and systems. They are essential for integrating testing equipment into existing networks and ensure fast and reliable data communication.
PC components:
Powerful PCs and servers are the heart of the IT infrastructure in hardness testing. They process the collected data, control the testing devices, and provide the computing power necessary for analyzing complex test results.
